EasyAPIChat.description: Create text and multimodal responses using models available to the selected connection and operation.

profile_id.name: Connection
profile_id.tooltip: Connection profile stored on the ComfyUI server. No API key is saved in the workflow.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model available to this connection and operation. The model ID is unchanged by language settings.

operation.name: Operation
operation.tooltip: Choose the supported operation. The saved protocol value stays unchanged when the interface language changes.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the result to create. Connected input values take precedence over the same fields in advanced parameters.

params_json.name: Advanced parameters
params_json.tooltip: JSON object for additional parameters. Basic and model-specific controls write to the same object; false, zero, arrays and objects are preserved.

wait_for_result.name: Wait for result
wait_for_result.tooltip: Wait for an asynchronous task to finish. Turn off to return its handle for a separate task node.

timeout.name: Wait timeout (seconds)
timeout.tooltip: Maximum local wait. A timeout or local stop keeps the task available for resuming and does not cancel upstream billing.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: ComfyUI IMAGE input. The connected image is used directly without manually creating a URL.

mask.name: Mask
mask.tooltip: ComfyUI MASK input for supported image edits. A value of 1 selects the area to edit.

audio.name: Audio
audio.tooltip: ComfyUI AUDIO input with waveform and sample rate.

video.name: Video
video.tooltip: Native ComfyUI VIDEO input. Supported requests transfer the file as a stream.

references.name: Additional references
references.tooltip: Optional reference group from EasyAPI References. Model metadata determines which roles and counts are supported.
